sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first
draft initiated by eng. Ekramy Mostafa Mohamad, accepted by technical expert eng Hassan El-Behiry, and approved by eng. فتحي السيد head 
 sector of Kurimat PS.

This document 
 certified by eng. جمال الدين عبد الوهاب UEEPC general director of
 inspection & quality control and MPIS Coordinator
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل 
 is required.

Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, 
 safety glass ...etc
Disconnect all power to motor prior to initiating any maintenance or repairs.
Avoid contact with rotating parts.

Act with care in accordance with prescribed procedures, in handling and 
 lifting this equipment.

Be sure unit is electrically grounded and proper electrical installation 
 wiring and controls are used consistent with local and national electrical 
 codes. refer to "national electrical code handbook" NFPA NO. 70. employ 
 qualified electricians.

Be sure equipment is properly enclosed to prevent access by children or other 
 unauthorized personnel in order to pre vent possible accidents.
تأكد من أن مفتاح العمود مقيد بالكامل قبل تنشيط الوحدة.

Always be sure oil lubricated units are filled with correct oil to proper 
 level before operating.

Provide proper safeguards for personnel against rotating parts and 
 applications involving high inertia loads which can cause over speed.
Avoid extended exposure to equipment with high noise levels.

Observe good safety habits at all times and use care to avoid injury to 
 yourself or damage to your equipment.

Be familiar with the equipment and read all instructions thoroughly before 
 installing or working on equipment.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
التفكيك
Disconnect power to avoid starting of motor.

Unbolt and remove grills or 
shrouding (if applicable).
Remove bearing cap screws.

Remove all thermostats. 
probes, thermocouples etc., from bearings and brackets.

Remove bracket to stator bolts 
and remove brackets.

Remove bearings from motor 
shaft with a bearing puller. Pull on inner bearing race to remove without 
damage.

sections.text: إعادة التجميع
Clean all machined and mating surfaces on bearing caps, bracket fits.

Remove old grease from grease cavities and refill cavities approximately 50% 
 full with recommended grease. See Table 2 for correct grease.

Carefully inspect ball or roller bearings for nicks, dents or any unusual wear 
 patterns. Replace bearing if damaged.
Reassemble motor by reversing the disassembly procedure.
Touch up any scratched or chipped paint to protect motor surfaces.

sections.text: Rough Alignment

Inspect sole plate mounting pads and bottom of motor feet for dirt or 
 irregularities that would prevent the motor from seating properly.

Position and shim the motor such that the coupling hubs are aligned within 
 1/32 inch. The motor shaft must be slightly lower than the driven shaft to 
 allow for final adjustment shims.

sections.text: المحاذاة النهائية

Check to ensure that coupling hubs are not eccentric. Mount a dial indicator on 
a stationary part and read the eccentricity of the outside diameters of the 
coupling hubs as they are rotated.

Check to assure that coupling 
hubs are not eccentric. Mount a dial indicator on a stationary part and read the 
eccentricity of the outside diameters of the coupling hubs as they are rotated.

Check to be sure that the 
motor feet lie in the same plane.
Bolt the feet down securely.

Mount a dial indicator on the 
driven half of the coupling.

Take readings of the movement 
of the motor half of the coupling as the feet bolts are loosened.

Loosen a shaft end foot bolt, take a reading and re-tighten. On the same side of 
the motor, loosen the opposite shaft-end foot bolt and take a reading.

Now add shims to the feet until motion of the coupling is less than 0.003" when 
either foot bolt is loosened.
Repeat this procedure for the foot bolts on the opposite side of the motor.
Check for angular misalignment of motor to driven unit shaft. (See Figure 2A.)

Measure distance between coupling hub faces (with feeler gauges) 
at four places equally spaced around the outside diameters.

Position motor as necessary to be within the max allowable 
misalignment of 0.001 in. per foot of coupling radius.

Check for offset alignment; Fasten a dial indicator on one coupling hub with the 
indicator button contracting the alignment surface of the opposite coupling hub. 
(See figure 2B)

Rotate shaft onto which the indicator is attached and take 
readings at four points 90 Deg. apart.

Relocate motor until total indicator movement, in a full 
rotation does not exceed 0.002 inches.

Transfer indicator to opposite hub and repeat the offset 
alignment procedure.
Recheck angular alignment as described in Step C.

sections.text: Miscellaneous

Tighten the foot bolts securely and recheck alignment after 
 each corrective adjustment .
Change only one foot at a time when making shim adjustments.

Recheck alignment after the motor has been in service 
 approximately one week, readjust as necessary.

Electrical Connection

Refer to the motor nameplate for power supply requirements and to the 
 connection diagram on the motor.

Be sure connections are tight. Check carefully and assure that they agree with 
 the connection diagram, then carefully tape all connections with electrical 
 tape, to be sure that they will not short against each other or to ground.
Be sure the motor is grounded to guard against possible electrical shock.

sections.text: Reversing Rotation

The direction of rotation may 
be reversed by interchanging any two, of the three power leads to the motor 
leads.

Be sure that the power is off 
and steps are taken to prevent accidental restarting of the motor before 
attempting to change any electrical connections.

sections.text: Vibration

After alignment has been completed. run motor at minimum possible load 
 (uncoupled from driven equipment if possible) and check for vibration.
إذا كان الاهتزاز مفرطًا (انظر الجدول 1)، فقم بفك أحد مسامير تثبيت المحرك.
If vibration decreases add shims and retighten bolt.

Repeat as necessary for all bolts until vibration is reduced to acceptable 
 limits.
إعادة الفحص. محاذاة اقتران بعد أي تغيير في الحشوات.

Recheck vibration after unit has run under full load and has reached operating 
 temperature.

Bearing Motors

Motors with Automatic Grease Drain Construction (see figure

To relubricate bearings, add

Remove grease accumulations at drain to prevent grease entering

Excess grease in bracket reservoir will be automatically purged 
while motor is running

Remove The lower grill periodically and clean any hardened or

Motors with Removable Plug 
Drain Construction (see figure 1B).

To relubricate 
bearings, remove the drain plug and add new grease until clean 
grease appears at the drain.

Run the motor for approximately ten minutes, with the drain plug 
removed to allow purging of the excess grease.

Replace the drain plug after 
the excess grease has been purged.

وضع المعدات في 
الخدمة
Initial Starts as follow:

تأكد من أن توصيلات المحرك والجهاز تتوافق مع الأسلاك 
 الرسوم البيانية.

Assure that voltage, phase, and frequency of line circuit 
 (power supply) agree with motor nameplate.
Check insulation resistance.
Check all foundation and base bolts to assure they are tight.
Check for proper or desired rotation.

Assure that all protective devices are connected and operating 
 properly.

Run motor at no-load long enough before connecting it to be 
 certain that no unusual condition develops. Listen and feel for excessive 
 noise, vibration, clicking, or pounding. If present, stop motor immediately. 
 Investigate the cause and correct before putting into service.

When checks are satisfactory to this point, operate at the 
 minimum possible load and look for any unusual condition. Increase the load 
 slowly and check unit for satisfactory operation.

Loosen a shaft end foot bolt, take a reading and re-tighten. On the same side of 
the motor, loosen the opposite shaft-end foot bolt and take a reading.
Now add shims to the feet until motion of the coupling is less than 0.003" when 
either foot bolt is loosened.
Repeat this procedure for the foot bolts on the opposite side of the motor.
Check for angular misalignment of motor to driven unit shaft. (See Figure 2A.)
Measure distance between coupling hub faces (with feeler gauges) 
at four places equally spaced around the outside diameters.
Position motor as necessary to be within the max allowable 
misalignment of 0.001 in. per foot of coupling radius.
Check for offset alignment; Fasten a dial indicator on one coupling hub with the 
indicator button contracting the alignment surface of the opposite coupling hub. 
(See figure 2B)
Rotate shaft onto which the indicator is attached and take 
readings at four points 90 Deg. apart.
Relocate motor until total indicator movement, in a full 
rotation does not exceed 0.002 inches.
Transfer indicator to opposite hub and repeat the offset 
alignment procedure.
Recheck angular alignment as described in Step C.
